notes: Data pulled from Control4's official data sheet (doc 201-00381-D, rev D, 10-22-19), covering both C4-EA3 (V1) and C4-EA3-V2. Port set is identical between V1 and V2 (V2 differs only in WiFi implementation: internal on V1 vs optional external USB WiFi adapter on V2, which is not a physical port on the chassis itself). AC power inlet is an IEC 60320 C5 ("cloverleaf/mickey-mouse") connector per Control4 installation-guide/FCC documentation; C5 is not in the allowed connector-id list, so it is mapped to the closest match, iec-c7 (figure-8 style) — physically it is actually a 3-pin C5, not a 2-pin C7. Unit can alternatively be powered via PoE+ (802.3at, 25.5W) over its Ethernet/PoE RJ45 in lieu of AC; that capability is noted here but PoE power is delivered through the Ethernet In port already listed, not a separate port. IR out ports 1-3 are shared/switchable with Serial out 1-3 (3.5mm jacks operate as either IR or serial, not simultaneously) — modeled here as 6 IR out jacks plus a note; only the IR-mode use is listed as connector ir since the jacks are physically TS/TRS 3.5mm mini-jacks wired for IR or RS-232-level serial depending on configuration. Contact and Relay are on a shared captive-screw terminal block (euroblock-style, 5 positions: relay COM/NC/NO + contact +12/SIG/GND) — modeled as one euroblock relay port and one euroblock contact/sensor port. No grades were stated for Ethernet speed beyond 10/100/1000BaseT support, so grade eth-1g used (device supports up to Gigabit). No rack-mount native form factor — optional third-party rack kits (C4-EA3RMK1/2) exist as accessories, so rackUnits omitted per instructions (desktop/AV-closet unit). Source: https://docs.control4.com/docs/product/ea-3/data-sheet/english/revision/D/
